title: llamafactory: torch-load-unsafe @ v1/core/utils/checkpoint.py:334
install: pip install llamafactory==0.9.5 (wheel pinned; env venv-lfa)

root_cause.note: TrainingCheckpointCoordinator.resume restores the dataloader state via torch.load(weights_only=False) on <ckpt>/dataloader/rank_<n>.pt. Same trust boundary as the rng_state sink: checkpoint write access equals pickle code execution on resume. Reproduced through the real upstream resume() flow (metadata.json + dataloader state only; the model path is absent so the surrounding code is inert) with the pinned installed package.

preconditions: attacker can write a LlamaFactory v1 training checkpoint directory
victim resumes training from that checkpoint (resume_from_checkpoint)
steps: craft metadata.json plus a malicious dataloader/rank_0.pt payload
drive the real TrainingCheckpointCoordinator.resume() and observe the marker inside torch.load
expected_evidence: marker written by the pickle payload inside the upstream torch.load call
run.json + log.txt with the pinned wheel sha256 and source hash
cleanup: temporary files under evidence/ are rewritten on every run
